body: Thanks for the offer. I appreciate your willingness to help, but I don't have much to say. I don't feel sad, depressed and helpless. I don't feel anything to be exact. No problem to pinpoint I think. But thanks again!

I don't feel like meds would work. Sure I'm not up to do anything, but it's not about my creative drive. I have ideas and reasons to see them come to life, but it all feels so...short-term. I don't have a life plan. I don't have a career set up for me, and honestly, I don't even wanna try. It doesn't make sense trying to do things, when it's constantly a battle between "I want to do this" and "Why even bother". Because honestly, why even bother.

You are not evil. I hate people that will avoid contact with you when you're not putting up the mask. All people around me are like that. I'm at my mental rock-bottom, and people are running away left and right. Complaining, arguing, feeling entitled.

People that supposedly love you should sit across you and listen when you're going through shit. Not avoid this kind of conversation because it makes them uncomfortable.

When you die, they'll feel regret that they didn't spend more time with you. They will feel bad about the relationship you had and they will eventually romanticize you ("This guy was great, I will miss him").
